grammar.summary: 本课学习过去完成时背景与 jeans 场景的对比叙事。

points.title: 过去完成时表先发动作
points.explanation: She had gone into the shop... but was thrown out before... had done 表先于过去基点。

examples.en: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
examples.cn: 招待她的店员不喜欢她的穿着。

points.title: the way + 从句
points.explanation: the way she was dressed = 她穿着的方式，the way 后接定语从句省略 that/in which。

examples.en: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her.
examples.cn: 那个店员没认出她是谁，急切地想招待她。
